summary: Multi-file upload per document line — 16/16 backend pytest PASS + full frontend UI validation. Borrower (linked sponsor) can upload N files to one doc line; each returns unique file_id; /client/me returns files[] in insertion order with uploaded_by tag; deleting last file resets status to 'pending'. Admin upload-on-behalf tags uploaded_by='broker' and appears in borrower view. Admin scenario docs.zip bundles ALL files across ALL lines. Lender view exposes file_count + files[] when viewable, supports file_id query param, per-doc zip, and all-docs zip includes every file. Legacy backward-compat: /populate_doc_files returns files:[] even for empty rows. Doc delete cascades — all underlying client_files rows removed. Frontend: borrower portal shows N files chip, per-file delete, 'Add file' relabel (verified 2-file upload then delete). Admin scenario Documents tab renders per-file listing with '+ Add another file' link, BROKER tag on admin-uploaded file, individual delete icons.
